title: xanthomyrtus scolopacina
intro: Xanthomyrtus scolopacina, commonly known as the Red-berried Myrtle, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is a shrub or small tree belonging to the family Myrtaceae. The health benefits of Xanthomyrtus scolopacina include its potential to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, and have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities.
